entries.name: G0A.SUM
entries.note: sum of a numeric Vector (0 for empty)

entries.name: G0A.WORDS
entries.note: split a String on single spaces into a Vector of words

entries.name: G0A.BYNAME
entries.body: ZIP [ 'N' 'A' ] BIND N A GROUP 'G' BIND G KEYS G VALUES [ G0A.SUM ] MAP RECORD
entries.note: Record from name to summed amount, names in first-appearance order

entries.name: G0A.MEAN
entries.body: 'V' BIND V G0A.SUM V LENGTH DIV
entries.note: arithmetic mean of a numeric Vector

entries.name: G0A.UNWORDS
entries.body: 'V' BIND V 1 DROP V 0 GET [ 'E' BIND ' ' E 3 COLLECT JOIN ] FOLD
entries.note: join a non-empty Vector of Strings with single spaces

entries.name: G0A.ARGMAX
entries.note: index of the first largest number in a Vector

entries.name: G0B.TOPKEY
entries.body: 'T' BIND T KEYS T VALUES -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET
entries.note: key of a Record with the largest value; first on ties

entries.name: G0A.MEDIAN
entries.body: SORT 'V' BIND V LENGTH 'N' BIND V N 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR N 2 DIV FLOOR 2 COLLECT GET G0A.MEAN
entries.note: median of a non-empty numeric Vector
